blocks.text: Viruses ko jandar (organisms) nahi mana jata kyunke yeh acellular hain: yeh cells se nahi bane. In mein zindagi ke teen domains ki khasoosiyat nahi hotin, is liye inhein kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi rakha jata. Ek virus nucleic acid (DNA ya RNA) par mushtamil hota hai jis ke gird protein ka ghilaaf hota hai. Viruses apna koi metabolism nahi chala sakte; apni nakal banane (replicate karne) aur proteins banane ke liye yeh host cell par inhisaar karte hain, jo poday, janwar ya bacteria ka cell ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Capsid aur ICTV
blocks.text: Virus ke nucleic acid ke gird protein ke ghilaaf ko capsid kehte hain. Viruses ki classification kai khasoosiyat par hoti hai: un ka genetic material, replication ka tareeqa, shakal (morphology), aur woh kin hosts ko infect karte hain. Yeh classification International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) ke banaye hue usoolon ke mutabiq (according to) hoti hai.

blocks.title: Prions aur viroids
blocks.text: Prions aur viroids bhi acellular hain, aur inhein bhi zinda jandar nahi mana jata. Prions sirf protein se bane hote hain. Viroids sirf gol (circular) RNA se bane hote hain. Dono qisam ke zarraat (particles) kuch podon mein mutaddi (infectious) bimariyan paida karte hain.
Host range ki buniyad par classification

items: Animal viruses janwaron ko infect karte hain, insaan samet. Misaalein: influenza virus, rabies virus.
Plant viruses podon ko infect karte hain. Misaalein: tobacco mosaic virus, potato virus X.
Bacteriophages bacteria ko infect karte hain. Misaalein: T4 phage, lambda phage.
Archaea viruses archaea ko infect karte hain. Misal: Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus.
Helical viruses ka capsid helical (pech-daar seerhi jaisa) hota hai jo nucleic acid ke gird lipta hota hai. Misaalein: tobacco mosaic virus, rabies virus.
Icosahedral viruses ka capsid symmetrical icosahedral shakal ka hota hai (bees tikoni satahon wala). Misaalein: adenoviruses, herpesviruses.

Complex viruses ki banawat pecheeda hoti hai; aksar icosahedral aur helical dono khasoosiyat milti hain, aur kabhi dum (tail) jaisi mazeed banawatein bhi. Misal: bacteriophages, yani bacteria ko infect karne wale viruses.
Enveloped viruses ke capsid ke gird bahar ki taraf lipid ka envelope (ghilaaf) hota hai jo host cell ki membrane se liya gaya hota hai. Misaalein: influenza virus, HIV.
Non-enveloped (naked) viruses mein bahar ka lipid envelope nahi hota; yeh sirf capsid par mushtamil hote hain jis ke andar nucleic acid hota hai. Misaalein: poliovirus, adenovirus.

blocks.alt: Viruses ki paanch buniyadi shaklein, naam ke saath: helical (pech-daar nucleic acid ke gird disc jaisi capsid units ka dher), icosahedral (bees satahon wala capsid, lambe fibres ke saath), complex (bacteriophage: kai-pehlu sar, dum aur dum ke fibres), enveloped (capsid ke gird kaanton wala envelope) aur non-enveloped (saada icosahedral capsid, chhote ubhaar).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.30: Viruses ki buniyadi shaklein (kitab ki Figure 1.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Helical virus mein capsid ki units nucleic acid ke gird seerhi (spiral) jaisi tarteeb mein hoti hain, jaise tobacco mosaic virus. Icosahedral capsid ki 20 tikoni satahein hoti hain, jaise adenovirus. Complex shakal mein icosahedral sar aur helical dum dono hote hain (bacteriophage). Enveloped virus ke capsid ke bahar host cell se liya hua lipid ka envelope hota hai jis par kaante (spikes) hain, jaise influenza; non-enveloped virus mein yeh envelope nahi hota, jaise poliovirus.

blocks.alt: Paanch virus particles ka 3D model, label ke saath: protein units ke kundal se bani helical chhari; bees tikoni satahon wala icosahedral capsid; complex bacteriophage jis ka icosahedral sar, dum ka ghilaaf aur dum ke reshe hain; enveloped virus jis ka icosahedral capsid spikes wale lipid envelope ke andar hai; aur bina envelope ka naked icosahedral capsid.
blocks.caption: Viruses ki buniyadi shaklein (Figure 1.30 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Helical: protein units nucleic acid ke gird lipat kar chhari banate hain. Icosahedral: bees tikoni satahon ka band khol. Complex: sar aur dum, jaise bacteriophage mein. Enveloped: capsid host cell se liye gaye lipid ghilaaf mein lipta hua. Non-enveloped: nanga capsid.

blocks.text: Genetic material ki buniyad par classification

items: DNA viruses ka genetic material DNA hota hai. Yeh DNA single-stranded (ssDNA, ek dhaage wala) ya double-stranded (dsDNA, do dhaagon wala) ho sakta hai. dsDNA viruses: adenoviruses (saans ki nali ke infections) aur herpesviruses (herpes, chickenpox). ssDNA viruses: parvoviruses (gastroenteritis).

RNA viruses ka genetic material RNA hota hai. Yeh RNA single-stranded (ssRNA) ya double-stranded (dsRNA) ho sakta hai. ssRNA viruses: coronaviruses (COVID-19) aur influenza viruses (flu). dsRNA viruses: rotaviruses (gastroenteritis).

blocks.text: Replication ke tareeqe ki buniyad par classification

items: Positive-sense RNA viruses: RNA genome ko host cell ke ribosomes seedha proteins mein translate kar dete hain. Misaalein: poliovirus, hepatitis C virus.
Negative-sense RNA viruses: RNA genome ko pehle ek viral RNA polymerase mRNA mein transcribe karta hai, aur sirf us ke baad translation hoti hai. Misaalein: rabies virus, Ebola virus.

Reverse-transcribing viruses reverse transcriptase enzyme ki madad se ek DNA intermediate ke zariye replicate karte hain. In ka genome RNA ya DNA ho sakta hai. RNA genome: retroviruses jaise HIV, jo AIDS paida karta hai. DNA genome: hepadnaviruses jaise hepatitis B virus.

blocks.title: Ek virus kai lists mein kyun aata hai
blocks.text: Chaaron classifications ek doosre se azad hain. Influenza virus host ke lihaz se animal virus hai, shakal ke lihaz se enveloped, genetic material ke lihaz se ssRNA virus, aur replication ke lihaz se negative-sense RNA virus. Adenovirus animal virus hai, icosahedral aur non-enveloped, aur dsDNA virus.

items: Viruses acellular hain, is liye kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi: protein capsid mein nucleic acid, apna koi metabolism nahi.
Prions (sirf protein) aur viroids (sirf circular RNA) acellular zarraat hain jo kuch podon mein bimari paida karte hain.
Host range: animal, plant, bacteriophage, archaea virus.
Shakal: helical, icosahedral, complex, enveloped, non-enveloped.
Genetic material: dsDNA, ssDNA, ssRNA, dsRNA.
Replication: positive-sense RNA, negative-sense RNA, reverse transcribing (RNA ya DNA genome).
In sab ke usool ICTV banata hai.

blocks.prompt: HIV ko chaaron buniyadon par classify karein, aur batayein ke bacteriophage shakal ke lihaz se complex kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: HIV: host ke lihaz se animal virus; shakal ke lihaz se enveloped; genetic material ke lihaz se RNA virus; replication ke lihaz se reverse-transcribing retrovirus. Bacteriophage mein icosahedral sar ke saath helical dum aur dum ke reshon jaisi mazeed banawatein hoti hain.
